test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 11 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.**

One-to-one interaction with parents is know to be important.
solution:
The correct answer is "**with parents is know**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the error lies in the part "with parents is know."
 
• **The error is in the verb form "know" which should be "known" to match with the subject "interaction".**
 
• **This is an example of a subject-verb agreement error.**
 
• **Known** is the past participle of **know.**
 
• We use known to describe someone or something that is clearly recognized by or familiar to all people or to a particular group of people.
 
• The correct sentence should be "One-to-one interaction with parents is known to be important."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.
